name: Cymbal
author: Emilie Gillet
description: Braids' CYMBAL: six square oscillators through a resonant bandpass, crossfaded against clocked noise through a resonant highpass. Free-running, not self-enveloping.

controls.label: Color
controls.description: Crossfades from the resonant metallic noise to the resonant raw noise, the module's own COLOR.

controls.label: Tone
controls.description: Sets the cutoff shared by both filters, from a dull thud to an open, bright hiss.

controls.label: Spread
controls.description: Scales the five detuned partials' distance from the root, from unison to double the module's own spread.

controls.label: Resonance
controls.description: Scales both filters' resonance around the module's fixed setting, from damped and dull to near-ringing.

outputs.main: The crossfaded pair, Braids' own signal.
outputs.aux: Mono: the complementary crossfade, always favouring the side MAIN does not. Stereo: a second, independent raw-noise stream and a small opposing offset on Color.
